actual_request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE high-definition transparent game sprite frame. Image 1 is immutable snow summoner girl identity. Image 2 is approved clean rounded Daoist chibi painted style. Image 3 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its entire upper body, head, costume, fox, snowflake, framing and scale unchanged. Only redraw the legs and the very bottom hem for the specified genuine walk pose. No copy, mirror, warp, interpolation, or translated pose.
Keep the same right-facing camera and two boot tracks. This is one phase BEFORE reference 3: the REAR boot at SCREEN-LEFT supports weight on its toe with heel just lifted, toe visibly reaching the baseline. The FORWARD boot at SCREEN-RIGHT has not landed: extend its shin ahead and leave its heel hovering a small distance above ground with toe slightly up. Do not plant the forward foot yet. Compact stride; grounded rear toe at the same baseline y as the usual grounded sole. Two legs must be separate and anatomically connected.
Two anatomically connected legs only. Keep same short chibi proportions, camera and facing. Full body isolated on transparent RGBA canvas, native at least 1024 square. Highest finish. No added tail, no floor, shadow, grid or text. Both original boots point in same direction as her nose. At least one foot supports body weight. Preserve all original identity and accessories.
